adrs.decision: Cloud runtime is Cloudflare Workers, D1, R2, Durable Objects, Queues, Workflows, Stream.
Seven deployment units. Domain modules compose inside those units.
TenantDataContext is the path to tenant data.
V1 D1 uses Control + shards. Per-tenant D1 is the target once dynamic attach is GA.
R2 uses prefixes, a small set of product buckets.
Queues by function with DLQ. Workflows by class, instantiated per run.
Akademate Identity for the academy. Cloudflare Access for Platform Ops.
Agents execute through Policy Engine and Control API. Models through AI Gateway.
Platform Billing (BRIK64 Stripe / Mercury) is a separate box from tenant learner payments.
Plane 2 stays at one institutional account per system.
